dataset: HaGRID (HAnd Gesture Recognition Image Dataset) & ASL Communicative Vocabulary
architecture: Random Forest (100 estimators, 38D scale/translation-invariant geometric features)
data_origin_disclosure: Trained and evaluated on synthetically perturbed landmark templates (12,000 samples across 24 classes, 500 samples/class derived from 1 canonical pose per class). Manifest test accuracy (86.83%) reflects synthetic perturbation testing with template leakage across train/test splits. Authentic in-the-wild video/image capture and empirical cross-signer validation remain outstanding.

CALL.label: CALL
CALL.desc: Thumb and pinky extended wide, middle three fingers folded.

DISLIKE.label: DISLIKE
DISLIKE.meaning: I do not like this / Bad
DISLIKE.desc: Closed fist with thumb extended pointing straight downward.

FIST.label: FIST
FIST.desc: All five fingers curled tight into a solid clenched fist.

FOUR.label: FOUR
FOUR.desc: Four fingers extended upright with thumb folded across palm.

HELLO.label: HELLO
HELLO.desc: Open hand flat salute wave facing camera.

HELP.label: HELP
HELP.desc: Fist with thumb upright resting or held steady.

I_LOVE_YOU.label: I_LOVE_YOU
I_LOVE_YOU.desc: Thumb, index, and pinky extended upright, middle and ring curled.

LIKE.label: LIKE
LIKE.desc: Closed fist with thumb extended pointing straight upward.

MUTE.label: MUTE
MUTE.desc: Single index finger held vertically near lips or mouth.

NO.label: NO
NO.desc: Index, middle, and thumb tips touching together, other fingers closed.

OK.label: OK
OK.desc: Thumb and index tips touching in an O ring, remaining fingers upright.

ONE.label: ONE
ONE.desc: Index finger extended straight upright, other fingers closed.

PALM.label: PALM
PALM.desc: All five fingers fully extended with open flat palm facing camera.

PEACE.label: PEACE
PEACE.desc: Index and middle fingers extended upright apart in a V shape.

PEACE_INVERTED.label: PEACE_INVERTED
PEACE_INVERTED.desc: Index and middle fingers in V with back of hand facing camera.

ROCK.label: ROCK
ROCK.desc: Index and pinky extended upright, middle and ring curled under thumb.

STOP.label: STOP
STOP.desc: Open flat palm facing camera held upright with stopping gesture.

STOP_INVERTED.label: STOP_INVERTED
STOP_INVERTED.desc: Back of open flat hand facing camera with fingers upright.

THANK_YOU.label: THANK_YOU
THANK_YOU.desc: Flat open hand moving outward from chin.

THREE.label: THREE
THREE.desc: Index, middle, and ring fingers extended upright, thumb holding pinky.

THREE2.label: THREE2
THREE2.desc: Thumb, index, and middle fingers extended, ring and pinky folded.

TWO_UP.label: TWO_UP
TWO_UP.desc: Index and middle fingers extended upright together without spreading.

TWO_UP_INVERTED.label: TWO_UP_INVERTED
TWO_UP_INVERTED.desc: Index and middle fingers extended pointing downward.
